 Everything’s on the menu at Wonder. Except compromise.
   

  

 Wonder is the mealtime platform built to feed every craving in one order. **About The Opportunity**
 We are looking for a Robotics Software Engineer to bridge the gap between high\-level orchestration and low\-level machine control. In this role, you’ll develop robotics software to revolutionize the restaurant industry. You will collaborate closely with cross\-functional teams. This includes software, hardware, and product development. You will design and build scalable software solutions. You should have experience working with software, electronics, and mechanical systems.
   

  

 The ideal candidate will have experience working on real time software, share our passion for robotics reliability, and be excited to grow with us. If you love robotics and have a passion for food, we’d love to talk to you.
   

  

**The Impact You Will Make**
* Pragmatic Problem Solving: Working with food can be a big challenge. The ideal candidate for this role will come at technical challenges with an open mind for creative solutions. You will utilize industry standards to implement new solutions within the robotics software suite.
* High\-Speed Feature Delivery: We move fast to launch new robotics products in a dynamic market. The ideal candidate will write clean, production\-ready code quickly without sacrificing architecture or quality. You will balance rapid prototyping with scalable design to accelerate our development cycles.
* Produce High Quality Software: We are proud of the phenomenal uptime we have on our existing robotics software infrastructure. The ideal candidate for this role will champion robotics software reliability. As part of this role, you will develop simulations and test suites that will ensure flawless delivery of software across hardware platforms.
* Engineering at the intersection of Hardware and Software: As part of the robotics software team you will solve challenges that improve our restaurant technology. This includes development of new features within our Python Robotic control framework, adapting software to updated hardware designs, and improving machine reliability through robust machine error handling .
* End\-to\-End Product Ownership: You will help build a brand\-new robotics product from the ground up. This role offers the unique opportunity to leave your mark on a major new initiative. You will own core software components from initial concept to deployment to support, directly shaping the final product.


**What You Bring To The Table**
* 3\+ years Python development experience in a workplace environment
* 2\+ years experience in Robotics, Automation, Mechatronics or related field
* Experience developing new software products, focusing on scalable and reliable system architecture
* Experience programming scheduling/planning algorithms
* Knowledge of networking principles
* Experience applying Object Oriented design principles
* Experience integrating software with new sensors/actuators


 This role requires 4 days a week in the office. You're welcome—and encouraged—to be in the office up to 5 days a week if it works for you.
